papers.title: Strategy as a theory of change
papers.abstract: Abstract Research Summary The theory-based view argues that a strategist's task is to develop a theory to move the organization to an improved future state. Focusing on theorizing as a thought process of model creation, we propose a framework to specify hypothetical causal links and analyze their structure as a directed graph connecting inputs, activities, and indicators of problem resolution. We then propose a set of metrics operationalizing key theory attributes: complexity, equifinality, interdependence, and circularity. We discuss the strategic relevance of these attributes in terms of a theory's ability to promote comprehensive problem resolution as well as implement, evaluate, and replicate the proposed solution. Our work represents a step toward operationalizing model creation in the theory-based view.
papers.summary_ja: 「変化の理論」として戦略を操作化する新フレームワークを提案し、因果構造の複雑性・等終結性・相互依存性・循環性の4指標で評価する方法論を示す。ビジョン・戦略デザインにおける介入ロジックの明示化に直結する。

papers.title: Configuring innovation portfolio management practices in an era of emerging digital technologies
papers.abstract: Organizations that innovate with emerging digital technologies increasingly manage portfolios in which activities differ not only in risk and maturity, but in the kind of management they require. Research on innovation portfolio management has often approached the portfolio as a managerial object whose practices can be optimized, offering limited guidance for managing heterogeneous portfolios in contexts shaped by emerging digital technologies. Drawing on interviews with 26 informants in seven incumbent Scandinavian organizations, this study explores how organizations differentiate and configure their innovation portfolio management practices.
papers.summary_ja: デジタル新興技術時代に求められるイノベーション・ポートフォリオ管理の3つの構成パターン（製品開発型・ビジネスモデル革新型・技術探索型）をタクソノミーとして提示する。

papers.title: The future workplace: developing the human-machine symbioscape
papers.abstract: Purpose This paper develops the concept of the human-machine symbioscape to explain how work environments shape collaboration between humans and AI-enabled machines. Extending servicescape thinking from customer-employee encounters to hybrid human-machine work systems, the paper positions environmental design as a core antecedent of human-machine adaptive collaboration, with particular relevance for service and frontline settings where visibility, coordination, and role clarity are critical. Design/methodology/approach The paper is conceptual and theory building in nature. It synthesises insights from biological symbiosis, servicescape research, sociotechnical and sociomaterial theory, organisational sensemaking and team adaptation research to develop a deductive typology of the human-machine symbioscape.
papers.summary_ja: AI搭載機械との協働を形成する職場環境を「人間-機械シンビオスケープ」として概念化し、可視性・調整・役割明確性の3次元で4類型の協働デザインフレームを提示する。

papers.title: Collective Sensemaking When Purchasing Complex B2B Services: How Buying Centers Construct and Align Interpretations of Vendor Service Offering
papers.abstract: Buying centers evaluate complex B2B service offerings not by aggregating independent assessments but through collective interpretive processes that buying center theory has documented structurally without explaining. This study introduces collective service offering sensemaking as a theoretical lens that explains how buying centers construct, contest, and align interpretations of a vendor's service offering. Drawing on a multi-phase qualitative multiple-case study of six organizations (24 interviews, 3 focus groups, 5 procurement-meeting observations; 2022-2024), we show that service evaluations originate in identity-rooted interpretive frames that differ across technical, financial, procurement, and operational roles.
papers.summary_ja: バイイングセンターがB2Bサービス提案を評価する際に、役割ごとの解釈フレームを集団的センスメイキングへと収束させるプロセスを6組織の質的研究で実証する。

papers.title: Staging participatory design in time-constrained contexts
papers.abstract: This article examines how participatory design can be staged in time-constrained contexts where traditional workshop formats are difficult to sustain. While participatory design has long emphasized the importance of sustained engagement with participants, real-world conditions often impose severe time constraints that challenge these ideals.
papers.summary_ja: 時間制約のある文脈での参加型デザインを「上演（staging）」として捉え直し、制約下でも参加の質を担保する方略を実践的に示す。

papers.title: Integrating service design methods into design ethnography: Preparing for field research in hospital Emergency departments
papers.abstract: This article discusses the service design and ethnographic preparation methods employed in the initial discovery phase of a co-design research project, aimed at enhancing the blood culture pathway for potential sepsis patients in UK emergency departments. It explores how service design methods such as journey mapping and personas were integrated with ethnographic preparation approaches to enable more effective fieldwork.
papers.summary_ja: 病院救急部門でのコデザインプロジェクトにおいて、サービスデザイン手法（ジャーニーマッピング・ペルソナ等）をデザインエスノグラフィーの発見段階に統合する方法論を提示する。

papers.title: Dynamic Capabilities and Sustainability: Recognising the Past, Comprehending the Present, and Shaping the Future
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Dynamic capabilities have become central to how organisations respond to increasing pressure to embed sustainability in their strategic agendas. Despite growing scholarly attention, understanding remains fragmented about which dynamic capabilities matter most for sustainability, how they interact, and what conditions enable or constrain their deployment.
papers.summary_ja: ダイナミック・ケイパビリティ研究をサステナビリティ経営と接合するシステマティックレビューで、DCのどの次元が持続可能性対応に最も寄与するかの全体像を提示する。

papers.title: How Assumptions About Time Divide and Connect Epistemic Communities in Business and Management
papers.abstract: Abstract Business and management studies comprise distinct epistemic communities that frequently do not interact or collaborate. While this has been explained as paradigm incommensurability, constructive disengagement, and institutional dynamics, this article argues that temporal assumptions play an equally important but overlooked role in dividing epistemic communities.
papers.summary_ja: 経営学研究コミュニティの対話断絶の要因を「時間的前提の不一致」として再解釈し、異なる時間軸で思考する集団を橋渡しする方法論を提案する。

papers.title: Designing for tomorrow: A case study exploring post-growth values
papers.abstract: While industries increasingly pursue sustainability, global emissions remain far above the levels required to meet 2030 climate targets. The post-growth paradigm responds to this challenge by emphasizing sufficiency and degrowth rather than efficiency alone. This case study explores how design practice can embed post-growth values and what this means for the design profession.
papers.summary_ja: 「ポストグロース（脱成長）」パラダイムをデザイン実践に埋め込む可能性を探るケーススタディで、持続可能性の限界を直視したデザイン価値観の転換を検討する。
